subject.title: [Feature]: Merge iOS Privacy and Location card state

question: Should Settings > Privacy collapse the current Location-derived Privacy summary into the Location card with the requested Location Sharing switch and Access Level row?
rationale: The duplicate state is source-proven, but replacing the segmented picker with Apple Settings-style controls is visible UX/product direction rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve narrow card merge
options.body: Remove the standalone Location-derived Privacy card, make Location the single state owner, and require focused tests for the new card contract.

options.title: Keep the current segmented UI
options.body: Leave the duplicate-card cleanup open only if maintainers want the existing Privacy summary and segmented picker preserved until a broader redesign.

options.title: Defer to broader location posture
options.body: Track only desired/effective permission and background-location policy elsewhere while accepting that this duplicate-card UX remains unresolved for now.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow card merge
recommendation.body: Remove the standalone Location-derived Privacy card, make Location the single state owner, and require focused tests for the new card contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on both iOS Location permission behavior and the same Privacy destination makes steipete the best available owner for the UX direction call.
